title: Belajar Tari Condong Legong Keraton - Tutorial Tari Bali Bagian 1

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher introduces the lesson and breaks down each movement step-by-step with numbering and verbal prompts. She then brings in a second dancer to demonstrate alongside her while providing physical adjustments.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces herself and the dance part being taught.
List of 8 movement sections of Tari Condong Bagian 1 displayed on screen.
Teacher demonstrates the first movement section alone with counts.
Teacher has assistant Emi perform while she guides and corrects her.
Assistant Emi practices the dance to music.

what_works: Showing the list of movements at the start gives clear structure.
Demonstrating solo first and then with a student helps learners see both execution and correction.
what_hinders: Lack of slow breakdown with verbal counts during the partner demonstration.

quotes.text: kita akan belajar bersama-sama tentang tari Condong bagian pertama.
Baiklah, kita langsung saja dengan praktik.
Nah sekarang kita coba dengan menggunakan musik ya.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher stands in front of camera speaking to introduce the lesson.
Teacher demonstrates footwork and hand positions while counting aloud.
Teacher physically adjusts student's arm position during practice.

extraction.distinctive_method: Having the instructor demonstrate the sequence solo first, then coaching a student dancer live on camera with physical adjustments before music practice.
